ZX Oncology | Clinical Research Manager | Remote| Full-time

ZX Oncology is a Columbia-spinout building CT-radiomics response-prediction models for EGFR-mutant NSCLC, working with a world-leading oncology center and pharmaceutical/biotech sponsors running Phase 1-3 oncology trials.

You'll own protocol design and site-relationship management across a growing multi-sponsor pipeline. Prior clinical research coordination/management experience in oncology trials required, including experience working with pharmaceutical or biotech sponsors; comfort navigating IRB, DUA, and sponsor contracting a must.

Market rate: $110,000-$160,000 base + equity. Email cbdo@rasalingham.com with "CRM - HN" in the subject.
